name: railway
description: Provision, deploy, and operate containerized apps and dev/staging environments on Railway.io: Docker-image services, managed databases (postgres/mysql/redis/mongo), persistent volumes, public domains, env vars, build/deploy logs. Use to stand up a host for an app, clone a production site into a disposable container, or deploy a Dockerfile to the cloud. Wraps the authenticated `railway` CLI (weapon: railway). Read refAuthSetup first; provisioning is billable — the cost gate is a LOCKED escalate.
